item.text: The new replay confirms a regression: the cyclic lane fold disappeared entirely, so the signed-widen refinement must be removed. The remaining question is whether the mismatch is owned by participant projection or by address-stage routing; I’m checking only the named `address_coordinate_folds` contract term.

I’m separating the cyclic participant projection and the explicit signed widening into two ordered realization stages. This preserves the source-visible lane fold instead of letting the refinement replace it, while keeping the cast as a distinct compiler-visible stage.

Updated [output/candidate.json](/workspace/output/candidate.json) with distinct cyclic-projection and signed-widen realization stages.

The candidate passes CandidateCheck and SourceReconcile. Formal-gate evaluation remains host-owned.
